extractor.note: Read every paragraph carrying transcend- (outside transcendental) or immanen-, in file order.

coverage_note: Term-led pass over the whole file (lines 1-399): every paragraph containing the transcendence family, including bare transcendent and immanent, was read; paragraphs without such a word were not read.

units.claim: Disposition objectifyingly reaches beyond the genuine immanent sphere, while phenomenologically only the immanent matters, inner characters grasped in pure adequation.
units.quote: Disposition, by contrast, is a concept that objectifyingly reaches beyond the genuine immanent sphere.

units.claim: The naive view errs in thinking of the mental image as a thing really immanent in the mind.
units.quote: The phenomenological response: the naive view errs in thinking of the mental image as a thing really immanent in the mind.

units.claim: An image can function representatively inwardly, as immanent imagehood, or outwardly, as symbolic representation.
units.quote: An image can function representatively inwardly, in the manner of immanent imagehood; or it can function representatively outwardly, in a manner that essentially amounts to the consciousness of symbolic representation.

units.claim: Sensations are primarily apprehended as self-present, and on this are built the empirical apprehensions constituting what is transcendently perceived.
units.quote: They are primarily apprehended as self-present, and upon this are built the extending empirical apprehensions constituting what is transcendently perceived.

units.claim: The kinship of immanent, inward-turned image-consciousness with phantasy-consciousness is resolved: immanent image-consciousness is phantasy-consciousness.
units.quote: In fact, the consciousness is in essence the same on both sides: this immanent image-consciousness is phantasy-consciousness.

absences.expected_because: The non-actuality of the image-object is the ground on which §16 separates immanent from symbolic imagehood.
